definitions.explanation: A very loud, deep, reverberating sound, such as that of engines, explosions, or thunder.

examples.japanese: {轟音|ごうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{轟音|ごうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえなかった→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The roar of the airplane drowned out the conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{轟音|ごうおん}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧。
examples.english: The windowpanes of the building shattered with the thunderous sound of the explosion.

notes:
Describes an extremely loud, deep sound that can be felt physically. Stronger and more dramatic than ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧ (noise), which focuses on unwantedness rather than volume.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {轟音|ごうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (a roar reverberates)
- {轟音|ごうおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (make a thunderous sound)
- {轟音|ごうおん}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧ (with a roar)
- ⟦すさまじい→すさまじい：07674_susamajii⟧{轟音|ごうおん} (a tremendous roar)

Often appears in literary and journalistic writing to convey dramatic impact. The kanji {轟|とどろ}く means "to roar" or "to rumble."
